briefings.title: AMNC26 - What to expect from "Summer Davos"
briefings.tldr: The 17th Annual Meeting of the New Champions (Summer Davos 2026) in Dalian, China, brings together over 1,700 global leaders to focus on scaling technological innovation amidst a highly contested geopolitical landscape, while energy experts debate whether recent geopolitical shocks will ultimately accelerate or hinder the global transition to green energy.
